description: Heat spreading along a 1 m rod whose ends are held at fixed temperatures (a grid field). Left: the rod over time, temperature as colour against position. Right: the temperature along the rod now. The hot spot spreads and fades towards the straight line between the end temperatures; change them while it runs. The rod is tracked at 50 points with RK4; a much larger diffusivity or a shorter rod needs more substeps to stay stable.
